title: Rabindranath Tagore's birth chart
metaDescription: Rabindranath Tagore's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 16.6° Taurus. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the nine placements whose signs are settled fall in fixed signs, the widest weighting the unknown hour leaves certain. Fixed signs hold the middle of their seasons, and a fixed-heavy chart is read as one that consolidates and does not easily let go.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 16.6° Taurus. That falls in the second decan, 10°–20°, sub-ruled by Mercury in the classical scheme — a earth sign read through a fixed season.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts the Sun in the same degree of the zodiac from Venus, 1.2° off exact. A conjunction is the least negotiable aspect in the scheme — no distance to argue across, so the pair arrives as a single instinct. Behind it, the Sun square Jupiter at 1.3°, and Mercury trine Saturn at 2.2° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks one placement here. Venus in Taurus at 15.4° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Counting only the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the chart runs 4 earth, 3 fire, 2 air by element and 4 fixed, 3 mutable, 2 cardinal by modality. Earth weights a chart toward the material and the durable — what can be built, kept, and relied on. No settled placement falls in water — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Nothing was retrograde that day, which is less common than it sounds.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Aries for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 11.9° between midnight and midnight. That is quick enough to make the exact degree a neighbourhood rather than an address, and slow enough to leave the sign settled. At the noon reference it stands at 17.0°.
